meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 OpenCode 作为编码 agent,接入多家模型服务。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想让 OpenCode 充当编码 agent,且需要接入多家模型服务。
copy.tagline_en: Set up OpenCode as a coding agent to connect to multiple LLM providers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use OpenCode as your coding agent with multiple model backends.

howto.what: 装上后，代理运行器会新增 OpenCode 后端，但默认仍用 Claude。你可以为每个 agent 组单独切换成 OpenCode，并通过环境变量指定 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型来跑任务。
howto.when: 当你在命令行把某个 agent 组的 provider 配置为 opencode（运行 ncl groups config update --provider opencode 并重启）后，该组才开始用 OpenCode 跑任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, the agent runner gains an OpenCode backend, but Claude remains the default. You can switch individual agent groups to OpenCode and set environment variables to use models from providers like OpenRouter or DeepSeek.
howto.when_en: It takes effect only after you run `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` for a group and restart it; that group then uses OpenCode for agent runs.

say_en.text: Switch the agent group demo to the opencode provider
say_en.note: This runs the switch command and restarts the group.
